scRollups.rationale: 1 measured violation(s) against 1.1.1 Non-text Content. A screen-reader user meets an image with no alternative as "image" or, worse, as a filename. Where the image is a link or a button, the destination becomes unguessable and the page stops working rather than merely degrading.

No automated check covers 1.2.1 (human-only). Manual test: Find every prerecorded audio-only and video-only item. Confirm an alternative exists, is linked near the media, and actually conveys the same information — including speaker identification for audio.
No automated check covers 1.2.2 (human-only). Manual test: Play each video with sound off. Confirm captions exist, stay in sync, identify speakers, and cover non-speech audio that carries meaning.

No automated check covers 1.2.3 (human-only). Manual test: Play each video without looking at the screen. Note anything you cannot follow, then confirm an audio description or full text alternative covers it.
No automated check covers 1.2.4 (human-only). Manual test: For each live media feature, confirm real-time captions are provided and check their accuracy during an actual broadcast.
No automated check covers 1.2.5 (human-only). Manual test: Confirm an audio-described track exists and that it covers the visual information not present in the main audio.

axe.aria-hidden-body, axe.list, axe.listitem, axe.td-headers-attr, axe.th-has-data-cells ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 1.3.1 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: Compare the visual structure against the accessibility tree. Every grouping, heading level and label relationship that is visually obvious should be present in the tree too.

ai.reading-order cover 1.3.2 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Disable CSS, or read the page in DOM order, and confirm the content still makes sense in that sequence.

ai.sensory-instructions cover 1.3.3 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Read the instructions aloud without looking at the page. Anything you cannot follow depends on a sensory characteristic.
resp.orientation-lock cover 1.3.4 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Load the page in both orientations on a real device and confirm both are usable.

axe.autocomplete-valid, form.autocomplete cover 1.3.5 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: For each field collecting user information, confirm the autocomplete token is present and drawn from the WCAG input-purpose list.

axe.link-in-text-block ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 1.4.1 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: View the page in greyscale. Anything you can no longer tell apart or act on fails.

media.autoplay-audio cover 1.4.2 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Load the page and listen. If anything plays for more than three seconds, confirm a control to stop it is reachable immediately by keyboard.

1 measured violation(s) against 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum). The most-reported barrier there is. It affects users with low vision, ageing eyes, and anyone reading on a phone in daylight — a constituency far wider than the disability framing implies.

axe.meta-viewport ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 1.4.4 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: Zoom to 200% and read every page. Confirm nothing is clipped, overlapped, or pushed out of reach.

ai.images-of-text cover 1.4.5 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Look for text that cannot be selected. For each case, decide whether the presentation is genuinely essential — a logo is, a price list is not.

resp.reflow-320 cover 1.4.10 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: At a 320px viewport, confirm no horizontal scrolling is needed, and that anything that does scroll horizontally is genuinely exempt.

ui.non-text-contrast cover 1.4.11 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Measure the boundary of each control against its surroundings, and each state indicator against the state it replaces.

resp.text-spacing cover 1.4.12 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Apply the four spacing overrides via a user stylesheet and confirm nothing is clipped or overlapped.

ui.hover-content cover 1.4.13 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Trigger each tooltip or popover, then try to move the pointer onto it, dismiss it with Escape, and leave it alone to see whether it times out.

kbd.walk, axe.scrollable-region-focusable, axe.frame-focusable-content cover 2.1.1 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Unplug the mouse and complete every task on the page. Anything you cannot reach or activate fails.

kbd.focus-trap cover 2.1.2 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Tab through the entire page, including every dialog and embedded component, and confirm you can always get back out.

kbd.single-key-shortcut cover 2.1.4 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Identify every single-character shortcut and confirm it can be disabled or remapped, or that it only fires when its component has focus.

time.limit-adjustable cover 2.2.1 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Find every time limit. Confirm each can be disabled, extended, or adjusted — and that the warning gives at least twenty seconds.

motion.auto-moving cover 2.2.2 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Watch the page for ten seconds without interacting. Anything still moving needs a reachable pause, stop or hide control.

No automated check covers 2.3.1 (human-only). Manual test: Analyse video and animation with a photosensitivity tool such as PEAT. Do not eyeball this one — the thresholds are quantitative and the cost of being wrong is a seizure.

axe.bypass ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 2.4.1 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: Press Tab once on a fresh page load. Confirm a skip mechanism appears, works, and actually moves focus to the main content.

axe.document-title ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 2.4.2 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: Read the title of each page out of context and ask whether it identifies that page uniquely.

1 measured violation(s) against 2.4.3 Focus Order. A tab order that jumps around the page is disorienting for sighted keyboard users and incoherent for screen-reader users, who lose the relationship between a control and the content it belongs to.

axe.link-name ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 2.4.4 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: List every link on the page with its accessible name and read the list on its own. Any entry whose destination you cannot guess fails.

site.multiple-ways cover 2.4.5 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Confirm at least two of: site search, sitemap, navigation menu, or a table of contents — and that each genuinely reaches the pages.

axe.empty-heading, ai.heading-quality cover 2.4.6 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Read the headings alone as an outline of the page, and each label alone as a description of its field. Both should make sense without the surrounding content.

1 measured violation(s) against 2.4.7 Focus Visible. A sighted keyboard user who cannot see where focus is has to press keys and guess. This is the single most common real-world failure, usually introduced by a blanket `outline: none` in a reset stylesheet.

kbd.focus-obscured cover 2.4.11 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Tab through the page at several scroll positions with any sticky or floating content present, and confirm the focused element is never fully hidden.

ptr.gesture-alternative cover 2.5.1 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: For each gesture-driven feature, confirm a single tap or click alternative exists and is discoverable.
ptr.down-event cover 2.5.2 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Press down on a control, move away, and release. Nothing should have happened.

axe.label-content-name-mismatch cover 2.5.3 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: For each labelled control, confirm the accessible name starts with or contains the visible text, in the same order.

ptr.motion-actuation cover 2.5.4 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Identify motion-triggered features and confirm each has a conventional control and can be turned off.

ptr.dragging-alternative cover 2.5.7 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: For each draggable interaction, confirm the same result can be achieved with discrete clicks or taps.

1 measured violation(s) against 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum). Small targets are hard to hit with a tremor, a large fingertip, or a head pointer — and a mis-hit on a dense toolbar can trigger the wrong action rather than none.

1 measured violation(s) against 3.1.1 Language of Page. A screen reader picks its pronunciation rules from this attribute. Get it wrong and English is read with French phonetics — technically speech, practically noise. It is also the cheapest fix in the entire specification.

ai.lang-of-parts cover 3.1.2 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Find passages in another language and confirm each carries a lang attribute, excluding proper nouns and naturalised terms.

kbd.focus-context-change cover 3.2.1 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Tab through every control without activating anything. Nothing should navigate, submit, or open.

form.input-context-change cover 3.2.2 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Change each control with the keyboard. Confirm nothing navigates or submits without an explicit action, or that a warning precedes it.
Nothing this scan captured falls under 3.2.3. Re-check if the crawl missed part of the site.
Nothing this scan captured falls under 3.2.4. Re-check if the crawl missed part of the site.

site.consistent-help cover 3.2.6 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Identify each help mechanism — contact details, chat, self-help — and confirm its position relative to other content is stable across pages.

form.error-identification, ai.error-messages cover 3.3.1 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Submit each form with deliberate errors and confirm each error is described in text and programmatically associated with its field.

axe.form-field-multiple-labels ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 3.3.2 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: Inspect each control's accessible name, and confirm format and requirement information is available before submission rather than after.

ai.error-suggestion cover 3.3.3 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Trigger each validation error and confirm the message says how to fix it, not merely that something is wrong.

No automated check covers 3.3.4 (human-only). Manual test: Identify every consequential action and confirm at least one of: it is reversible, the data is checked and errors are offered for correction, or a review-and-confirm step precedes it.

form.redundant-entry cover 3.3.7 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Walk through each multi-step process and note anything you are asked for twice. Confirm each repeat is auto-filled, selectable, or genuinely essential.

form.paste-blocked cover 3.3.8 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Attempt to authenticate using a password manager. Confirm paste works, autofill works, and any puzzle step has an alternative.

axe.aria-allowed-attr, axe.aria-conditional-attr, axe.aria-hidden-body, axe.aria-prohibited-attr, axe.aria-valid-attr-value, axe.aria-valid-attr, axe.button-name, axe.duplicate-id-aria, axe.label, axe.link-name, axe.nested-interactive, axe.select-name ran and reported no failures, but no automated check can decide 4.1.2 outright — a failure-detector's silence is not a pass. A human must confirm: Inspect each custom component in the accessibility tree. Confirm it has the right role, a meaningful name, and that its state updates in the tree as you operate it.

aria.status-messages cover 4.1.3 but none of them ran on this scan, or none found anything to examine. Manual test: Trigger each status change with a screen reader running and confirm it is announced without focus moving. Check that live regions exist in the DOM before their content is inserted.
